method.restart: Controlled application close while dummy voice fetch is held, then relaunch same isolated userData

decision.Boris: Accepted after independent proposal and challenge; diff review found no actionable issue. ISO round-trip reservation addressed.
decision.Nadia: Supported optional origin metadata; preferred a bounded UI name fallback for deleted profiles.
decision.Morgan: Capture manual profile ID at action boundary; resolve name in main after synchronous reservation, unknown if deleted. Automatic uses supplied snapshot. Keep context outside inputHash and immutable on reconciliation.

limitations: Controlled provider and restart evidence, not billing, power loss or live outage proof.
